prompt:
Use case: original humanoid mascot redesign.
IMPORTANT USER CORRECTION: The user WANTS HUMAN-SHAPED CHARACTERS, NOT ANIMALS. They dislike naturalistic human child figures, but want familiar adorable HUMANOID MASCOTS. Reference image is the ORIGINAL 4 mascots of TOKKATSU広場 website; this is the PRIMARY identity, role, color, silhouette and simple illustration reference. Make these original human-shaped mascots much more charming and professionally designed. Do NOT turn them into animals. Do NOT render realistic children or 3D baby dolls. Do NOT borrow Mario-specific noses/gloves/shoes.
Produce one premium 2D humanoid mascot roster sheet, landscape 2:1, FOUR full-body original characters in a row on warm cream background, precisely legible Japanese names under each. Gentle warm thick dark contours and clear flat color shapes that fit the source homepage. This should feel like enduring familiar Japanese educational mascots, thoughtfully designed, not generic AI anime illustrations.
PROPORTIONS: about 1.7-2 heads tall, huge simple nearly circular head, very short rounded tunic-shaped body, stubby mitten-like HUMAN hands with a subtle thumb (no gloves), simple short legs, compact soft rectangular cream shoes. Head about 55% of overall height. NO animal ears/tails/beaks/paws. Small human ears allowed. Natural cream-peach face and hands, dark solid sculptural cartoon hair shapes. Minimal delightful face: two small black oval eyes, two simple brows, small smiling curve or small open smile, soft coral cheek dots, NO detailed irises, NO eye sparkles, NO big bulb nose; nose absent or tiny unobtrusive curved mark. Faces like approachable graphic mascot faces, not miniature human anatomy.
ART: confident slightly organic warm-charcoal outline, strong clean expressive silhouettes, flat colors with at most ONE tiny purposeful shadow shape. No gradients, 3D, texture, gloss, realism, elaborate hair strands, anime eyes, massive teeth, long limbs, baby dolls. Keep sophisticated intentional shapes, not merely circles and rectangles stuck together. Sympathetic expressive gestures. Each should be instantly recognizable as the source mascot but fuller of personality. All share ONE art style, proportion system and facial grammar.
PRESERVE these FOUR EXACT identities and order:
1 LEFT 「学活くん」: original green human-shaped mascot, big rounded-square head, dark softly domed short hair with one subtle side sweep, calm warm smile and kind brows. Forest-green loose rounded tunic with original short white vertical placket, tiny short legs and cream shoes. One short human arm waves, other holds little cream rectangular card with two green lines. Friendly dependable organizer, slight relaxed lean. Body simple rounded green shape. No green bear, no animal features.
2 LEFT CENTER 「行人」: original vermilion-orange human-shaped mascot, round peach face, short dark hair with just two small dynamic locks, iconic WHITE HEADBAND with short tied ends, orange tunic with WHITE HORIZONTAL CHEST STRIPE, tiny legs and cream shoes. Holds bright YELLOW TRIANGULAR FLAG on short dark pole, bouncy marching pose, one foot slightly up, joyful small open smile. Energy comes from pose not excessive facial detail. No rabbit ears.
3 RIGHT CENTER 「児童会ちゃん」: original school-blue human-shaped mascot, large round peach face, iconic TWO LOW ROUND DARK SIDE HAIR BUNS, simple smooth fringe, confident kind smile, blue A-line tunic, iconic YELLOW DIAGONAL SASH. Holds simple silver/cream handheld microphone with dark handle, other short hand extends invitingly. Tiny legs and cream shoes. Clear symmetrical human head with human hair buns, NOT bird, no beak or wings. Do not overdo eyelashes.
4 RIGHT 「クラブマン」: original yellow human-shaped mascot, broad round peach face, rounded short dark hair, BLUE HEADBAND, big cheeky delighted smile, sunny yellow rounded tunic with a single large WHITE FIVE-POINT STAR outlined dark on chest, short VERMILION-ORANGE CAPE. Both tiny human arms raised triumphantly, short legs planted apart, compact cream shoes. Playful homemade-superhero mascot. No dog ears/tail. The cape and star are this site's existing identity, retain them.
COLORS: original homepage forest green #1F5C3F, vermilion #D2552A, school blue #3A6EA5, golden yellow #E8C547, cream #FCFBF7, peach skin #F6D8B8, dark contour #1C1C1A. Keep source visual familiarity rather than changing everything. The improvement is appealing silhouette, polished character acting, big readable face, consistent adorable humanoid body proportions.
Composition: all four equally prominent with enough whitespace to see their silhouettes, all flags/hands/cape fully within frame, feet share baseline except marching pose. No cards, frames, backdrop illustrations, extra props, extra text or watermark. Exact names only under each: 学活くん / 行人 / 児童会ちゃん / クラブマン. User wants THEIR human-shaped mascot characters, much cuter and more memorable, neither realistic kids nor animals.
